sql: WITH un AS (SELECT split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',2) AS contest, p.market_ticker, mm.close_time FROM paper_trades p LEFT JOIN mmsell_settlement_meta mm ON mm.market_ticker = p.market_ticker WHERE p.strategy='mmsell10' AND p.created_at > now() - interval '48 hours'), agg AS (SELECT contest, count(DISTINCT date(close_time)) AS ndates, count(*) AS legs, string_agg(DISTINCT to_char(close_time,'MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' | ' ORDER BY to_char(close_time,'MM-DD HH24:MI')) AS closes FROM un WHERE close_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'A_straddling_uncapped' AS what, contest||' legs='||legs::text AS k, closes AS v FROM agg WHERE ndates > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'B_live_on_that_contest', split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',2)||' '||lo.market_ticker, COALESCE(lo.status,'?')||' '||to_char(lo.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM live_orders lo WHERE lo.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND lo.created_at > now() - interval '48 hours' AND split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',2) IN (SELECT contest FROM agg WHERE ndates > 1) UNION ALL SELECT 'C_paper_on_that_contest', split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',2)||' '||pt.market_ticker, COALESCE(pt.strategy,'?')||' '||to_char(pt.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM paper_trades pt WHERE pt.strategy IN ('Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4') AND pt.created_at > now() - interval '48 hours' AND split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',2) IN (SELECT contest FROM agg WHERE ndates > 1) ORDER BY 1,2
